exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Ether (ETH) traded at $2,380.18 as of 2026-10-20 09:45:54 UTC, -0.33% over one hour and -2.58% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $2,374.52 to $2,436.65; spot sits at 9% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -5.89% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($2,403.14) is below the 72-hour average ($2,405.24). Spot is 5.43% below the seven-day high of $2,516.82 and 1.91% above the seven-day low of $2,335.57.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 2.46% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 38.1, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $9.33 billion, equal to 3.21% of the $290.75 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 55 ("Greed"), versus 57 7 days earlier.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of $2,380.18 sits near the bottom of the 24‑hour range, only 9% above the low of $2,374.52, and is down 2.58% in one day, indicating a clear technical floor from which buyers can rally [Ex. A, B].  

2. Despite a modest 2.46% daily realized volatility, trading volume of $9.33 billion—3.21% of market cap—demonstrates robust liquidity that can absorb upward pressure without slippage [Ex. D, E].  

3. The Fear & Greed Index remains in “Greed” territory at 55, outpacing the 7‑day trend, while a 14‑hour RSI of 38.1 suggests momentum is poised to turn higher rather than stay depressed [Ex. F, D].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  
1. The spot price has slipped 2.58% in the past 24 hours and now sits at the bottom 9 % of its 24‑hour range, indicating sellers dominate and upward recovery is constrained [Ex. A, B].  
2. The seven‑day trend is sharply negative at –5.89 %, with the current level 5.43 % below the weekly high and only 1.91 % above the weekly low, showing a sustained downtrend that lacks a reversal catalyst [Ex. C].  
3. Momentum metrics corroborate bearish pressure: the 14‑hour RSI is 38.1, below the neutral 50 threshold, while realized volatility remains modest at 2.46 % per day, allowing the downside to persist without volatility‑driven rebounds [Ex. D].  
The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s reliance on RSI as bearish is misplaced; Exhibit D explicitly labels a 14‑hour RSI of 38.1 as “conventionally neutral,” not a sell signal. Moreover, the Bear ignores the prevailing bullish mood: Exhibit F shows the Fear & Greed Index at 55, solidly in “Greed” territory, contradicting any claim of dominant seller sentiment. These two points undermine the Bear’s narrative of inevitable decline. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s claim of a “technical floor” is hollow. ETH sits merely 9 % above the 24‑hour low, yet the seven‑day trend is –5.89 % and the spot is below both the 24‑hour (2,403.14) and 72‑hour (2,405.24) averages, indicating sustained bearish pressure, [Ex. B, C]. Moreover, the cited volume of $9.33 bn represents only 3.21 % of market cap, a modest share that cannot guarantee upward momentum, especially as the Fear & Greed Index at 55 is only mildly greedy and the 14‑hour RSI at 38.1 remains in weak territory, [Ex. D, E, F]. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds ETH/USD should be shorted for the next 24 hours.

findings.finding: ETH price fell 2.58% over 24 hours, indicating bearish pressure.
Seven‑day trend is –5.89% and spot is below 24‑hour and 72‑hour averages, confirming a downtrend.
RSI of 38.1 sits below the 50 midpoint and realized volatility is modest, limiting rebound catalysts.
Fear & Greed Index at 55 places market in Greed, a bullish sentiment factor.
24‑hour volume equals 3.21% of market cap, providing adequate liquidity but not a decisive bullish signal.

ruling.opinion: ETH has dropped 2.58% in the past day and sits near the low of its 24‑hour range, showing seller dominance [Ex. A, B]. The seven‑day trend remains sharply negative, with price below both the 24‑hour and 72‑hour averages, confirming a sustained downtrend [Ex. C]. RSI at 38.1, while labeled neutral, lies below the 50 midpoint, and low volatility offers little reversal catalyst [Ex. D]. Although sentiment is mildly greedy and liquidity is adequate, these factors do not outweigh the price and trend weakness, supporting a short practice position for the next 24 hours.
ruling.dissent: Despite the decline, the market remains in Greed territory and liquidity is solid; the neutral RSI suggests no oversold condition, leaving room for upside.
